_doc: The trailer's beats, in order, for `python3 tools/capture_gallery.py trailer [--movie] [--only id,id]`. Each beat is one windowed Godot run (1280x720, --fixed-fps 60): a showcase (`showcase`: a src/game/showcase.gd SCRIPTS id) or a CPU-vs-CPU match (`mode`: a main.gd MODES index, `arena` for the four map choices; Caravan 50 and Capture the Flag 52 play their own maps), with an optional `time`, `weather`, `cam` [x, y, zoom] (held camera) and extra `args` (main.gd flags). PNGs every `every` game frames (2 = 30 fps) from `from` to `to` (game frames, 60 a second; frames before 30 are never used) go to docs/gallery/trailer/<nn>_<id>/; --movie also writes <nn>_<id>.avi (MJPEG + WAV, from frame 0 to `to`). The trailer folder is git-ignored. Showcase lengths: tools/showcase_lengths.gd.
